description: Create a Rapyd managed wallet (user) for an end user. Rapyd's wallet differentiator: the merchant holds a master account and provisions sub-wallets per end user, enabling marketplace balances, creator payouts, and cross-border P2P without opening bank accounts per user. Returns an ewallet id (ewallet_xxx).

contact.description: Full contact object with address fields, date_of_birth, identification_type, identification_number, nationality, etc. Required fields depend on country and type.

ewallet_reference_id.description: Merchant-side stable reference id for this wallet

type.description: Wallet type. 'person' for end consumers, 'company' for business users, 'client' for merchant-owned master sub-accounts.

name: create_wallet
